targets.authors: Zhang, L. F., & Sternberg, R. J.
targets.title: Revisiting the investment theory of creativity.
targets.evidence_quote: Equally importantly, this study was to establish if the aforementioned two types of discrepancies found in Zhang and Sternberg’s (2011a) work can be replicated in this study.
targets.outcome_quote: In Zhang and Sternberg’s study, the mainland research participants rated intellectual styles as the most important resource for crea- tivity in their explicit evaluation of the six resources, while they indicated that intel- lectual styles would be the second most important resource when they evaluated the hypothetical cases. However, in the present study, whereas the Hong Kong partici- pants’ratings of boys were consistent with those in Zhang and Sternberg’s study, their ratings of girls were not.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors confirm the intelligence discrepancy and gender gap, but explicitly contrast the girls’ intellectual-style ratings with the original. Abstract confirms particular gaps rather than providing an overriding overall replication verdict. The measure citation 2011b is an unpublished test, not the target 2011a finding.
